statements.impact_statement: The reviewed linux/amd64 CGO-disabled Pong and standard Caddy 2.11.7 production import graphs contain x/crypto v0.57.0 primitives but exclude every golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp package. Docker builds fail if that package enters the graph. See security/openpgp-review.md for locked inputs and scan evidence. Legacy version scopes are retired; no other vulnerability or package version is authorized. This is a binary-specific absence assessment, not a fix for the unmaintained OpenPGP package.
